title: A Fecal-Microbial-Extracellular-Vesicles-Based Metabolomics Machine Learning Framework and Biomarker Discovery for Predicting Colorectal Cancer Patients.
summary: Fecal microbial extracellular-vesicle metabolomics in 36 CRC cases and 40 controls identifies five metabolite features; SVM 10-fold CV AUC .985 (35/36 cases, 39/40 controls). External replication and prospective utility were not established.
